theorems.name: Submission.backward_integral_gronwall_Ioc
theorems.statement: ∀ (a b Λ C : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 ≤ Λ → IntegrableOn f (Icc a b) → (∀ s ∈ Icc a b, f s ≤ C + Λ * ∫ τ in Ioc s b, f τ) → ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, f s ≤ C * Real.exp (Λ * (b - s))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
